background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production BACKGROUND ONLY for FocusQuest mobile character screen, based on LEFT design of the supplied concept board. Draw a bright premium Japanese RPG castle courtyard in coherent 16-bit pixel art, portrait 2:3. Blue sky, white pixel clouds, a distant elegant ivory castle on the RIGHT, stone arches and a royal blue gold banner at LEFT, ivy and small white flowers near edges, warm pale stone courtyard ground visible around the LOWER THIRD. Keep center open for a separately composited standing hero. All structures are original square-pixel clusters on a consistent 256-pixel-wide logical grid; hard aliased stepped edges, limited rich palette, no painterly smoothing. Upper half should frame the hero rather than a huge building obscuring them, lower half calm pale paving and greenery suitable behind information panels. No characters, no weapons, no labels, NO UI frames, NO text, NO buttons, no watermarks. This is a standalone reusable background, not a screenshot. Match the blue/gold/ivory feeling of the left proposal.

characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE standalone production pixel-art standing character PNG for FocusQuest's character page. Input is a reference board of ONE specific character: LEFT is the existing full-body illustration and is authoritative for weapon shape/count, equipment, outfit and accessories; CENTER is their actual battle pixel sprite, authoritative for pixel palette and face/body proportions; RIGHT is their approved pixel face, authoritative for hair and face identity. These are references, NOT content to reproduce as a collage. Draw ONLY this same character, whole body from top of hair to both boots, in a calm stationary upright standing stance, feet planted, torso turned three-quarter RIGHT, face looking RIGHT, weapons resting/held at rest. Do not draw a run/attack pose. Preserve existing hair color/style/length, clothing cut and colors, armor, footwear, weapon types and counts, wings, horns and equipment; this is NOT a redesign. Crisp handcrafted Japanese RPG pixel art using a 64 by 64 logical grid (delivered at 2x/128x128 intended asset), hard square pixel clusters, limited palette, no smooth gradients or antialiasing, same scale and proportions as the battle sprite. Center the entire silhouette and all weapons with at least 4 logical pixels clear padding. Feet at consistent baseline. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background, no floor, no shadow puddle, no frame, no text, no effects, no illustration panels, no labels, no second character. Keep the same recognizable design even though pose becomes standing.
Specific character: male warrior. Identity details: Blond hair, blue cape, white/cream tunic and brown leather armor, brown boots, ONE silver straight longsword matching the illustration.
